changelog: Valenixia POS v2.4.5 UX & Connectivity Patch resolving health probe timeouts, global content view scrolling, and subscription page single-screen width layout.
changes: Created static /healthz file for Vercel CDN edge 200 OK responses in <20ms
Increased license-engine.js health query timeout from 1.5s to 5.0s with JSON content-type verification
Updated ConnectivityMonitor probe timeout to 6s with fallback to /version.json probe
Fixed global page scrolling issue by enforcing overflow-y: auto !important and -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch !important across active content views in style.css and components.css

Refactored subscription page layout (#view-subscription) with responsive single-screen width container, auto-fit grid breakpoints (250px), and mobile NayaPay form stacking to eliminate horizontal overflow
